title: Semilocal convergence beyond exact majorization for an efficient three-step method under gamma conditions: supplementary material and reproducibility package
description: Research compendium containing the mathematical supplement S1-S6, exact rational and symbolic verification programs, coupled-field order counterexamples, high-precision Nystrom experiments, and complete generated data for the sufficient criterion 0 < beta*gamma <= 0.1547. File-level licensing terms are specified in LICENSE.md.
